title: Report: Broncos to put Pat Bryant on injured reserve

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Broncos to put Pat Bryant on injured reserve
sources.description: Broncos head coach Sean Payton said on Wednesday that he didn't think wide receiver Pat Bryant would be placed on injured reserve, but it appears something has changed about Denver's view of the wideout's ankle injury.
